Party walks together to the previously visited royal correspondence receiving office, presents existing limited messenger credentials/receipt, and asks for status; no fee, new audience, threat or player commitment. DM sets an independent Crown review progress d20 before rolling: 1–5 awaiting substantive review; 6–14 considered but undecided; 15–20 authority for limited exploratory talks only, never treaty or recognition. Actual user-visible Python secrets receipt 334bb876654ea4d3074bf603eb78962b d20 face6, considered but undecided. New offscreen development established in play from councillor's prior commitment, elapsed day, and actual roll: the frontier-security councillor has presented his favorable recommendation and confidential material for royal council review; the proposal has received initial substantive consideration, but no final royal instruction or authorization has been issued. Authorized correspondence staff verify status to the accredited limited messenger, stating 'The councillor's recommendation has been considered. No decision has yet been issued. We will send word to the Copper Hart when the Crown has given its instructions.' No disclosure of individual votes, secret proceedings, independent authentication of Kestrel allegations, royal assent, claim suspension/waiver, direct liaison, official timetable, signed reply, treaty, funding or troop commitment. Existing Ossent policy remains; both crowns retain their claims. No additional V check, feature expenditure, food/feed charge or rest. Party at correspondence office, V chooses next action.
